items.summary: Recommendation: reject all three proposed implementation requests this cycle and retain the financial-claim gate. Amazon data for 2026-09-21 reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all commission is on aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0. AI usage for 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-02 is $48.94121895 across 292 calls, 20 observed sites versus 40 expected, with 4 errors. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, ROI, causal lift, and forecasts are not calculable because revenue and AI spend are not period-aligned, AI allocation is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and budget limits are absent, and no outcome delta is causally matched to spend. Minimum measurement: a period-aligned site ledger containing attributable revenue, AI and infrastructure/domain costs, implementation cost, experiment exposure/control outcomes, and approved monthly budget ceilings. Continue only no-spend report-only finance reconciliation; do not move money, alter billing, access banking, contract, or make legal/tax claims.
